title: Umuhanuzi w'Imisozi Ibajwe .
intro: Mu bugaragwa bukomeye bwo muri Arabiya ya kera, hari umuntu yaserutse mu bantu bazwi cane kubera ubuhinga bwabo budasanzwe. Amazu yabo yari yubatswe n’urutare rukomeye, yamara imitima yabo yari ikomeye kuruta imisozi babaza. Intumwa y’Imana yarashitse ifise ikimenyetso kimwe, c’igitangaza — ariko ubwibone n’ugutera akagere vyatumye haba ingaruka zihuta kandi ziteye ubwoba. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo musuku w’icubahiro abantu biwe bahisemwo gutikizwa aho kuyoborwa?
clues: Natumwe kuba umugabisha abantu banje, mbahamagarira gusenga Imana imwe rudende.
Abantu banje baba hagati y’ibitandara biteye ubwoba, babaza amazu meza cane mu misozi.
Ingamiya y’ingore y’igitangaza yarasohotse mu rutare rukomeye mw’isengesho ryanje, ikimenyetso gitomoye kivuye ku Mushoboravyose.
Nabwiye abantu banje ngo basangire amazi n’iyi ngamiya y’ingore, ntibayigirire nabi.
Abantu banje baciye umugambi wo gutera ingamiya y’ingore, barayica imitsi, bashira ikidodo ku gutikizwa kwabo.
Umutingito uteye ubwoba wateye abantu banje, basigara baguye mu mazu yabo ata co bakora.
